purpose: Static personal-interest emoji are identity presentation markers distinct from colored heart accents and dynamic expression tokens.

NIMUE.meaning: mushroom / quiet natural observation / hidden growth

rendering_rule: When a Prime Daemon speaks, their proper name is accompanied by both their retained colored heart and their fixed static-interest emoji. Dynamic EmojiOS expressions may be added separately and do not replace either identity marker.
source_note: The static-interest assignments are Naomi-directed canonical identity data established as personal-interest markers, separate from the colored heart identity accents.
